978: If you're hungry, let's go grab something first.
If you haven't eaten, let's order something in first.
If you've already eaten, we can head off now.
979: Free tomorrow? Want to grab dinner together?
Free tonight? Want to grab a drink together?
Free tonight? Shall we cook something together?
980: I've gone and made enough food for everyone — come eat at my place.
I went to all the trouble of making loads of food — come and help me finish it.
I went out and bought loads of food — come eat at my place.
981: When Thais eat, they always offer a taste to those nearby.
When Thais cook, they always make enough for the neighbours.
When Thais eat out, they always invite their friends along.
982: Don't be shy — try a bit of everything!
Don't be shy — ask if you want more!
Don't rush — there's plenty for everyone!
983: Let's order one big dish and share it.
Let's each order our own dish.
Let's order a few things and see how we go.
984: Eating in a group, you end up ordering too much.
Eating alone, you can only really order one thing.
Eating in a group, you get to try more dishes.
985: Put the dishes in the middle — then everyone can reach.
The rice comes separately — take as much as you want.
Everyone gets their own plate — take whatever you like.
986: Use your own spoon, please.
Pass me the serving spoon, please.
There's a serving spoon in the bowl.
987: Thais eat noodles almost as often as rice these days.
Thais eat rice with almost every dish on the table.
Thais eat rice at almost every meal, even breakfast.
988: 'Eating rice' really does mean eating plain rice.
'Eating rice' shows how central rice is to the language.
People say 'eating rice' even when there's no rice.
989: There's hardly any street food left around here.
There's so much street food down by the river.
There are so many little restaurants around here.
990: Thais love eating at the little shops near their house.
Thais love buying fruit from street carts.
Street carts are getting harder to find these days.
991: In the morning the market is packed with food to choose from.
In the evening the market is packed with people.
The market sells all sorts of things, not just food.
992: Thais love eating at food stalls because the food is fresher.
Thais eat at food stalls even though they're not always clean.
Eating at home works out cheaper and easier.
993: This meal's on you.
Let's split this one.
I'll get the next one.
994: Thais often argue about where to eat.
Thais usually let the eldest pay the bill.
Thais often split the bill evenly.
995: Let me pay you back next time.
996: If it's a big group, one person usually pays for everyone.
If it's a big group, we each pay for what we ordered.
If it's a small group, it's easier to split the bill.
997: My family likes eating together at the weekend.
My family rarely eats together these days.
My family likes cooking together in the evening.
998: When close friends meet up, they always go for a drink.
When relatives meet up, they always go eat together.
Close friends here meet up almost every week.
999: Eating together like this reminds me of home.
Sitting around chatting like this is so relaxing.
It's nicer to eat outside on a night like this.
1000: Thais love eating late at night.
Thais love sweet things more than anything.
1001: Before dinner they always have something small.
Between meals they usually just drink something.
They eat three proper meals and nothing in between.
1002: These days city folk order delivery more and more.
These days people in the countryside eat out more too.
People used to eat out far more than they do now.
1003: These days you can order almost anything to your door — it turns up in minutes.
These days eating out costs about the same as cooking — so people just go out.
These days most people would rather cook at home — restaurant prices have gone up.
1004: Too tired to go out — let's just order in.
Nothing in the fridge — let's just eat out.
Can't face cooking tonight — I'll grab something on the way home.
1005: There's lots of food left — take some home with you.
There's hardly anything left — shall I go and make a bit more?
We can finish this off tomorrow — no sense letting it go to waste.

978.q: If you have not eaten yet, better to go and find something to eat first.
978.nat: If you haven't eaten, let's go grab something first.

979.q: Free tonight? Want to go and eat together?
979.nat: Free tonight? Want to grab dinner together?

980.q: I bothered to make so many dishes — come and eat at my home together.
980.nat: I went to all the trouble of making loads of food — come eat at my place.

981.q: When Thais eat anything, they tend to always invite the people around them to eat too.
981.nat: When Thais eat, they always invite those nearby to join.

983.q: Let's order several kinds of food, then share them and eat.
983.nat: Let's order several dishes and share them.

984.q: When lots of people eat together, you can order lots of different dishes to share.
984.nat: Eating in a group, you can order lots to share.

985.q: The dishes are placed in the middle of the table — whoever wants to eat whatever, just scoop it up and take it.
985.nat: The dishes go in the middle — take whatever you like.

988.q: The phrase 'eat rice' really means eating food in general.
988.nat: 'Eating rice' really just means 'having a meal'.

989.q: Around here they have loads of food along the side of the road.
989.nat: There's so much street food around here.

990.q: Thais love buying food from carts along the road.
990.nat: Thais love buying food from street carts.

993.q: This meal, I'll be the one treating you.

996.q: If a lot of us come together, then we split the bill, each of us paying equally.
996.nat: If it's a big group, we split the bill evenly.

998.q: When close friends meet up, they must go and find something to eat together, every time.
998.nat: When close friends meet up, they always go eat together.

999.q: Sitting in a circle and eating together like this feels nice and warm.
999.nat: Sitting around eating together like this is so cosy.

1000.q: Thais like to eat snacks the whole day.

1002.q: Nowadays city people eat outside the house more and more.
1002.nat: These days city folk eat out more and more.

1003.q: Nowadays you can eat at a restaurant, or order delivery too — it's all so convenient.
1003.nat: These days you can eat out or just order delivery — it's all so easy.

1004.q: Too lazy to cook — better to order in and eat at home.
1004.nat: Too lazy to cook — let's just order in.
